posts.title: Will OCPM consult on church buildings?
posts.description: The verb in the headline is conditional, but the OCPM may be preparing to consult the public on what to do about the disused churches degrading around town. The catch is that each case is different. Some churches have already been usefully repurposed. Some will have to be torn down. Some will need a case […]

posts.title: VSMPE mayor joins Ensemble
posts.description: Jean-François Lalonde, elected as Projet borough mayor of Villeray-St‑Michel-Park Ex a year ago, and who left Projet last month, has now joined Ensemble and been given the job of working on economic development and tourism. I did not vote for an Ensemble borough mayor, and not for a blatant opportunist either.
